verdict.rationale: Xero ships an official MCP server that bridges agents to its accounting API, plus an AI Toolkit covering the OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain and prompt examples. That lets an agent pull live ledger data. Xero also markets 'instant answers about your cash flow, profit trends and financial health.' However, the documented MCP features list only contacts, chart of accounts and invoices, not the cash, balance or report data an affordability question needs, and the cash-flow Q&A claim is not shown to run through the API. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for bank balances, cash flow or P&L reports, an example of an affordability-style query grounded in API data, and independent hands-on corroboration.
